title: Top tour
text: Great tour, very informative with a lot of personal commitment. Absolutely recommended!
author: Gaefu

title: The perfect way to explore
text: This was a fab way to explore the city as the use of a segway provided a lot of laughs and we could cover a larger area which enabled us to orientate ourselves more easily. Our guide was great too; very friendly and informative which helped make this whole experience exactly what we needed on our first day in Seville :-)
author: Mandy_C

title: Excellento
text: Excellent tour … easy enough to manage and amazing tour guide Javi … patient, friendly and knowledgeable. A must do for everyone
author: Mayank_V

title: Great way to see Seville 😎
text: Great way to see Seville, lots of fun and easy to use the Segway. Knowledgable guide and patient with everyone. Highly recommend 😎
author: 358andyw

title: Wow, what a way to see Seville.
text: We’ve been on many Segway tours but this is one of the best. Great guide- knowledgeable, perfect commentary and made sure we were safe amongst the crowds. Saw much more of Seville than we expected. Highly recommended.
author: sean_r

title: History and fun on a Segway
text: It was very informative, exhilarating and fun.  Our guide was interesting, knowledgeable and patient.
author: Dawn_T

title: Great guide!
text: Our guide spoke very clear English and was very knowledgable about the area and all the history.  Best guide yet!!
author: Taaron_M

title: Great experience in Sevilla
text: It was the great experience ever to learn about Sevilla history. The tour is well worthy in the Segway. It was our first time using it and we could learn to manage it very easily.
author: Jose_E

title: Segwey supreme
text: Great guide, patient knowledgeable and good Sense of humor. Highly recommend
